patch.value: Keep changelog checks stable when an empty release is tagged
Full-history checks add an empty Unreleased section after a package release tag appears.

Empty and item-bearing releases render byte-identically across tag publication; empty Unreleased does not displace releases; Randomized tests and revert proof cover aliases, older commits, same-day versions and no-git trackers; Document include-empty; audit git-optional dependency notes and record follow-up when unsupported; Public pm-jira, pm-ops and third tracker evidence; targeted tests, typecheck and npm/Bun CI release gates

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Closed pmc-itemless-pending covers git-derived notes, not include-empty visibility. Public pm-jira main 9ff81121748701c3f95e40e758ec28d89ac73805 reproduces the empty Unreleased diff. Current generator also differs from that consumer historical baseline in dependency notes and old item ordering; measure those separately from tag-only stability.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Selection fix omits empty Unreleased before limits on all item visibility paths, retaining empty versioned releases. Tag audit found default v-only discovery and duplicate calendar aliases; normalize equivalent tags into one window and accept unprefixed version tags by default. Different historical versions or changed commit boundaries are real release-history changes, so arbitrary tag-set independence is impossible; README documents that boundary and immutable milestone alternative. Git-optional merged-change receipt design is tracked in pmc-portable-change-receipts; no new git-only notes logic.
